notes.title: Dandy Ace Patch Notes v1.3.0.0.08
notes.content:
The goal of this update was to improve the early game player experience. Dandy Ace has an extremely punishing first 40 minutes. This often causes players to give up on continuing to play before advancing.

The causes of this, which we were able to fix, were:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/5e8d78ff5ca02078da1bcf624cfacc16117ea546.png[/img]
Potion: Originally, the player only received the first potion after winning the 1st Area (Entrance Hall). However, this potion makes a big difference at the beginning of the game.

Change: The change we made is to give Dandy Ace a potion from the beginning of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/cc98f1e09eb464d6528caf14dac1cf10e1c008b0.jpg[/img]
Blueprints: One element that was always frustrating in Dandy Ace was losing Blueprints when dying in a run. This caused several problems, such as making it take much longer than necessary to unlock and find new cards.

Change: Now the player no longer loses Blueprints when losing a run.

Nnif-tar: Nnif-tar is a mechanic that allows the player to choose a card and increase its level. The idea is not to make the game so dependent on RNG. However, Nnif-tar originally took a long time to unlock.

Change: Nnif-tar starts unlocked from the beginning of the game.

More balancing changes (card damage and costs) will come in future updates

Thank you very much!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/FhTMr5L/Boltof-Cards.png[/img]
[h3][b]Bolt of Cards[/b][/h3]
Ace Dashes forward. While dashing, 3 homing cards are shot from Ace.

Ace strikes with powerful swords in front of him. If an enemy is hit, an explosion is spawned behind them.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/tCSGPvr/Cloth-Galore.png[/img]

Ace shoots a projectile that, if connected with an enemy, will spawn Cloth Chain.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pwEyLxp.png[/img]

Ace fires a projectile that leaves an area upon colliding with enemies or reaching its maximum distance. If Ace enters this area, it explodes, causing damage to nearby enemies.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rZGh9tB.png[/img]
[h3][b]Fairies Blast[/b][/h3]
Ace fires 2 projectiles, on different activations. Once the 2 projectiles arrive at their final destination, a beam is shot between them, damaging any enemies caught in it.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jvAmd2Y.png[/img]
[h3][b]Overwhelming Presence[/b][/h3]
Ace creates an aura, damaging enemies inside.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/gwMq0G4/Masterful-Jump.png[/img]
[h3][b]Masterful Jump[/b][/h3]
Ace blinks to the nearest enemy, dealing damage upon arrival. If there's no enemy to jump into, Ace won't blink and the effect will trigger in the same position.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/U9ku99s.png[/img]
[h3][b]Intoxicating Trick[/b][/h3]
Ace blasts an area in front of him. The longer he holds the casting, the bigger it gets.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/n55o24f.png[/img]
[h3][b]Hex Maelstrom[/b][/h3]
Ace creates a magical field that inflicts enemies with Hex.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/J7xMtvH/ezgif-com-gif-maker-26.gif[/img]

[h2]Trinkets[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/i29Exrv.png[/img]
[h3][b]Cupcake Party[/b][/h3]
Potions heal less, but levels drop more cupcakes.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9a1zPeN.png[/img]

 Yellow Skills deal more damage. The damage increases as Ace progresses through the Palace.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/yh38CSS/Cloak-Of-Retribution.png[/img]
[h3][b]Cloak of Retribution[/b][/h3]
If an enemy hits Ace, that enemy will take damage back. The damage is proportional to the enemy's attack strength. The damage increases as Ace progresses through the Palace.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bkZfm6K.png[/img]
[h3][b]Guarana Infuser[/b][/h3]
Drinking Tea Potions grants Ace increased move speed for a few seconds.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/u3NnvtR.png[/img]
[h3][b]Assassin's Cloak[/b][/h3]
Ace deals more damage to nearby enemies. An area indicates the maximum range. The damage increases as Ace progresses through the Palace.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/xMcHTxv/ezgif-com-gif-maker-25.gif[/img]

notes.title: Dandy Ace 1.2.0.0.24 Update - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/65b6aeb27493b91b005ffe54ac5664592d3c6d4e.png[/img]
[u][h2][b]Mac Version[/b][/h2][/u]
The Mac version of Dandy Ace is now available (including the latest updates)!


[u][h2][b]Cards[/b][/h2][/u]
[h3][b]Dash Update[/b][/h3]
To address a lot of feedback from players about getting stuck on corners and feeling helpless while using dashes instead of blinks, we made a big change to them. Now dashes can pass through gaps, obstacles, and corners!

Provided that the player has enough room for the dash and that the distance isn't too far as well, any level obstacle can be crossed while dashing, making Ace way more mobile when using a Dash Card.

[h3][b]Stun Update[/b][/h3]
Previously stuns would stop enemy actions for the duration of the stun, resuming them as soon as the CC effect was over. We felt like this created some weird moments for players that were expecting a different reaction (especially considering how the other CC in the game works). In this patch we changed how stuns work to make them more consistent with other CC types, now completely resetting all enemy actions when stunned.

[i][b]Note:[/b][/i] Enemy skills will still be out of their cooldowns, so they will still attack Ace as soon as they are not stunned anymore. The difference is that they will start attacking from the beginning of the action instead of resuming from the middle of it.

[h3][b]Card Simplification Update[/b][/h3]
We simplified the visuals on a lot of skills in the game improving their clarity so players don't get overwhelmed with too much information happening at the same time and skills as well as enemies don't blend together in a big mess.

Besides helping clarity, these changes also positively impact the performance of the game.

[u][b]The cards affected by these changes are:[/b][/u]

[b]Five of a Kind[/b] (Main and Upgrade)
[b]Bubble Trouble[/b] (Main and Upgrade)
[b]Titan Punch[/b]
[b]Shooting Stars[/b]
[b]Hack N Slash[/b]
[b]Poison Roses[/b]
[b]Trump Card[/b]
[b]Cosmic Vortex[/b] (Main and Upgrade)
[b]Escape Artist[/b] (Lele)

[h3][b]Performer's Refuge Drop Rate [/b][/h3]
From what we have heard from players that were finishing 100% of the game, in most cases the last card blueprint they needed in order to find all of the blueprints was the Performer's Refuge blueprint, which should not happen. Because of that we increased its drop rate, doubling the percentage of chance for it to be found by players.


[u][h2][b]General Updates[/b][/h2][/u]
[h3][b]Optimization[/b][/h3]
We updated a lot of how the game works behind the scenes, improving greatly how the game runs in general. The main way players will feel these improvements is through the overall FPS of the game and the PC's memory usage while playing Dandy Ace.

[h3][b]Camera 60FPS Stutter[/b][/h3]
We have been receiving feedback since the game's launch from some players about the game feeling like it was stuttering while playing on 60 hz/FPS monitors. In this patch we managed to find what the issue was and fixed it, improving greatly how the game runs on these monitors.

[h3][b]Narration Frequency Update[/b][/h3]
We found that the way the narration frequency was being calculated on previous patches was not ideal, causing some players to feel like changing the frequency setting didn't change much during the actual gameplay. 

Trying to improve that, we changed how the cooldown between each Lele line was calculated, making it so the changes to frequency feel more impactful.

notes.title: Dandy Ace 1.1.0.0.8 Update - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/0f6655ea015ea80d979b41a9421fd022a7ba40b7.png[/img]
[h2][b]Cards[/b][/h2]
The focus on the Cards in this patch was mostly to make the melee cards stronger and better to use. As the gameplay was heavily dependent on the player's ability to kite the enemies, melee cards were not strong enough to compensate for not utilizing ranged cards.

[h3][b]Hack n' Slash[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Size increased:[/b] 15%
[*] [b]Base Damage increased:[/b]  34% (115 -> 155)
[*] [b]Casting Time decreased:[/b] 30% (0.1s -> 0.07s)
[*] [b]Recovery Time decreased:[/b] 30% (0.1s -> 0.07s)
[/list]
[h3][b]Titan Punch[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]First and Second Punch Casting Time decreased:[/b] 20% (0.1s -> 0.08s)
[*] [b]First and Second Punch Recovery Time decreased:[/b] 20% (0.1s -> 0.08s)
[*] [b]First and Second Punch dash force decreased:[/b] 30%
[*] [b]Third Punch Casting Time decreased: [/b]37.5% (0.2s -> 0.125s)
[*] [b]Third Punch dash force decreased: [/b]40%
[*] [b]All Punches Push strength decreased:[/b] 40%
[/list]
[h3][b]Spark Tornado[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Base Damage increased:[/b] 12.5% (200 -> 225)
[*] [b]Secondary Damage increased:[/b] 33% (37.5 -> 50)
[/list]
[h3][b]Five of a Kind[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Cooldown Decreased:[/b] 25% (0.8s -> 0.6s)
[*] [b]Collider Increased:[/b] 87.5%
[/list]
[h3][b]Flurry of Blows[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Base Damage increased: [/b]12.5% (400 -> 450)
[/list]
[h3][b]Starburst[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Base Damage increased:[/b] 28.5% (175 -> 225)
[/list]
[h3][b]Packet Trick[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Collider Increased:[/b] 50%
[*] [b]New Functionality:[/b] The explosive cards will also explode when the duration ends now. Before they only exploded if they made contact with an enemy.
[/list]

[h2][b]Dashes[/b][/h2]
Another big topic within the community was around our dash cards. We focused on improving the dashes usability and game feel, but we didn't add I-frames, as some players suggested (you can find a more detailed explanation on why we made this decision [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1037130/discussions/0/3082124889511586613/][b]here[/b][/url]).

The overall change was increasing how fast the dashes are, to make it more instantaneous, but also decreasing its distance. The distance is an important factor because the dashes were always covering a long distance, players would constantly take damage when dashing or they would have to pay more attention to farther parts of the map to dash safely.

The result of the change was a fast, almost instantaneous dash, with a more controlled distance. Allowing the players to be even more reactive without being too exposed during combat.
[list]
[*] [b]Increased Dash Speed:[/b] 60%
[*] [b]Decreased Dash Distance:[/b] 30%
[*] [b]Cooldown decreased:[/b] 15% (0.8s -> 0.7s)
[/list]
[h2][b]Starter Blue Card[/b][/h2]
Overall, new players gave us the feedback that they were finding blinks easier to use than dashes. Based on that, we decided to swap the starter blue card from a dash to a blink, with the objective to give a more friendlier experience to new players.
[list]
[*] [b]Starter Blue Card swap:[/b] Dashing Dash -> Time Warp
[/list]
[h2][b]Trinkets[/b][/h2]
In this patch we focused on strengthening some of the offensive trinkets. Players were not using these upgrades as much as we had hoped, since they didn’t feel quite as powerful as some of the other options.
[list]
[*] [b]Cloak of the Virtuoso damage increased: [/b]74%
[*] [b]Payback Knuckles damage decreased: [/b]20%
[*] [b]Pepperina Infuser damage increased:[/b] 90%
[/list]
[h2][b]Dandy Ace Movement[/b][/h2]
Another point of consistent feedback was that Dandy Ace's walk animation was a little bit "floaty" and that he was always moving too slowly. One of the biggest updates we made were to the walk animation, improving the gameplay feel. Now it feels like Dandy Ace is running in the palace and it feels much better!
[list]
[*] [b]Dandy Ace walk animation speed increased:[/b] 30%
[*] [b]Dandy Ace walk speed increased:[/b] 6%
[*] [b]Camera smoothness follow up decreased:[/b] 50%
[/list]
[h2][b]Shards and Grinding[/b][/h2]
One of the most frequent feedback was that to unlock Nnif's cards improvements were too expensive, forcing some players to grind it. For that, we decided to increase the bosses' shards reward. The idea is to allow the players to have access to more shards but only after defeating a boss.
[list]
[*] [b]Axolangelo and Scissorella shards drop increased:[/b] 50% (60 -> 90)
[*] [b]Severino shards drop increased:[/b] 50% (100 -> 150)
[*] [b]Lele shards drop increased:[/b] 50% (200 -> 300)
[/list]

[h2][b]Maps and Enemy Balancing[/b][/h2]
One of the biggest issues we saw within the early days of the game launch was that a lot of players were finding the Entrance Hall too difficult. Because of it, we decided to nerf some of the basic enemies, as well as targeting the Entrance Hall difficulty. The objective is to make the initial experience of the game more accessible and enjoyable.
[h3][b]Entrance Hall[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Enemy Encounters:[/b] Overall, we decreased the amount of enemies the player will face in each combat encounter in this stage. Less enemies, more time for the player to learn the game. As for experienced players, playing through the Entrance Hall will be faster. It's a win-win change.
[/list]
[h3][b]Bunny Butler[/b][/h3]
As the Bunny Butler is the most basic enemy in the game, his attack was too strong. It was either too hard for the player to dodge or it was always putting the bunny in a position after the attack where new players weren't able to punish the enemy.
[list]
[*] [b]Charge Casting Time increased:[/b] 50% (0.4s -> 0.6s)
[*] [b]Charge distance decreased:[/b] 33%
[*] [b]Charge attack distance decreased:[/b] 20% (Now bunny butlers need to be 20% closer to the player to start the attack)
[*] [b]Walk speed increased:[/b] 15%
[/list]
[h3][b]Bunny Jester[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Tumble Cooldown increased:[/b] 50%
[/list]

[h2][b]General Changes[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Card Tier Assist[/b][/h3]
One of the most important concepts of our card system is the Card's tier. Basically, the higher the Card tier is, the more damage it deals. As a consequence of this, as the player progresses through the palace, the enemies are also higher tier. This means that if a player doesn't change their cards to higher tier cards or upgrade them with the Niftar unlock, the damage output will start to get too low, making it very difficult to beat the game.

However, one of the hardest part for new players is to understand the importance of the tiers amidst of all the cards, upgrades, and enemies. To aid the players, we added a visual cue system that will help players to understand the relative power of their cards compared to the map they are in.

notes.title: Welcome to the Central Hall: Royal Rabbit, Broom Maid, & More!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/23a02201fd3bd65d74749a17387df708c8e0b65e.png[/img]
[h3][b]CENTRAL HALL[/b][/h3]

The [b]Central Hall[/b] is the next map in our map and enemy spotlight series. As the name might suggest, the Central Hall is located at the center of Lele’s Palace and can be entered through the Banquet Hall or Courtyard if you have the necessary gate keys to unlock the paths. This map is home to a variety of new challenging enemies for Ace to take on including the [b]Broom Maid[/b], [b]Candlestick Bombardier[/b], [b]Royal Rabbit[/b], [b]Twilight Phantom[/b], and [b]Multi-Shot Turret[/b]. Ace will also need to be careful navigating the Central Hall as it features Protective Totems and a different kind of environmental hazard, the [b]Furnace[/b]. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/zVW8LhF/Central-Hall-Gif.gif[/img]

While making your way through the Central Hall you’ll be able to find two possible exits, one to [b]Axolangelo’s Atelier[/b] and the other to [b]Scissorella’s Garden[/b]. This allows you to decide which boss you want to face depending on the cards you have, better adapting your decision to each of their playstyles.

[h3]FURNACE[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/8cc8a58898555e9d548fec5f3f11015a10273f2d.png[/img]

The Central Hall’s environmental hazard will surely heat things up in the midst of combat. The [b]Furnace[/b] requires Ace to step on the pressure plates found on the ground in the Central Hall to activate them. These plates can’t be activated by enemies. After a short delay, flames will erupt out of every vent in the hall damaging anything standing on top of them. The pressure plates will reset after a short period and can be activated by Ace again.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/QfFpXYG/Furnace-Gif.gif[/img]

[h3]CANDLESTICK BOMBARDIER[/h3]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/648e00fccc5a3e3bcf9c12c9347a1a774a514ed8.gif[/img]
          [/code]
The [b]Candlestick Bombardier[/b] is an upgraded version of the Candlestick Bomber found in earlier maps. Similar to the Bomber’s [b]Blast[/b] offensive skill, the Candlestick Bombardier can cast [b]Cluster Blast[/b] underneath Ace’s location from range. After a short delay the area will explode dealing damage to Ace if he remains within it. Following the initial explosion, 4 smaller [b]Blasts[/b] will occur surrounding it in a cluster. Attempting to get close to the Candlestick Bombardier will cause it to [b]Teleport[/b] a good distance away from Ace before resuming its attacks. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/6rySp5t/Bombardier-Gif.gif[/img]

[h3]ROYAL RABBIT[/h3]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/7666bad6db16e645c159be168175b4a4fc1298c3.gif[/img]
          [/code]
An upgraded version of the Bunny Butler, the [b]Royal Rabbit[/b] relies on a lance as its weapon of choice instead of a giant fork. This enemy is much tougher than the Bunny Butler that Ace encounters in the Entrance Hall so don’t underestimate it! If Ace remains at range the Royal Rabbit will attempt to get in close enough to [b]Charge[/b] in Ace’s direction, damaging him on collision. The Royal Rabbit also has a melee attack at its disposal with [b]Thrust[/b] should Ace get too close.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/NSj6SC3/Royal-Rabbit-Gif.gif[/img]

[h3]BROOM MAID[/h3]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/34f1ec2302510b5fd22f335068f880f414a3075a.gif[/img]
          [/code]
The [b]Broom Maid[/b] works hard to keep the Central Hall clean and doesn’t take kindly to guests making a mess. [b]Flame Sweep[/b] is a mid-ranged two part attack that activates once the Broom Maid is within range of Ace. The Broom Maid will swing her broom in the direction of Ace leaving a trail of flames. This attack is performed twice in a row. The flames will disappear after a few seconds.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/vqRTqQX/Broom-Maid-Gif.gif[/img]

[h3]TWILIGHT PHANTOM[/h3]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/18e3a8b0f71ca8fab7663a77ed1bdfa597af20d8.gif[/img]
          [/code]
The [b]Twilight Phantom[/b] is the upgraded version of the Midnight Phantom. Armed with both a ranged and melee offensive skill, the Twilight Phantom will always be a threat. [b]Boomerang[/b] fires a projectile ring that returns to the Twilight Phantom once reaching its max range. Any enemies that it collides with will take damage. Getting too close will cause the Twilight Phantom to activate [b]Combo Slash[/b], swinging at Ace 3 times and moving in his direction quickly.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/FztPjr9/Twilight-Phantom-Gif.gif[/img]

[h3]Multi-Shot Turret[/h3]

The Central Hall has a different type of turret than those found in previous maps. The 
[b]Multi-Shot Turret[/b] has 3 projectiles floating above it. Acting as the shotgun of turrets, the Multi-Shot Turret fires [b]Spread Shot[/b] towards Ace when within range. Spread Shot sends out 3 projectiles in a cone simultaneously, each dealing its own damage on successful hit. Ace will need to quickly maneuver between the multiple projectiles while fighting off enemies.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/hBpXM8R/Multi-Turret-Gif.gif[/img]


The Central Hall is currently available in the free demo during our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1037130/view/3047216285005208414][b]Creators’ Preview Event[/b][/url] until February 1st. Head on over to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1037130/Dandy_Ace/][b]Dandy Ace Steam Page[/b][/url] to wishlist and play! Twitch Streamers can also try out our updated Twitch Mode that allows their chat to directly impact the game through votes in chat. We’d love to hear your feedback so join us on [url=https://discord.gg/EDby5gp]Discord[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/DandyAceGame]tweet[/url] at us, we’re always looking to improve Dandy Ace as we approach launch early this year!

notes.title: Dandy Ace's "Twitch Mode"
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/c245d420a1e5cf9acc022e7a74f2d32cd8dfd231.png[/img]

The Dandy Ace team has been having a blast watching all of the streamers playing in Twitch Mode during our [b]Dandy Ace Creators’ Preview Event[/b] so far. Everyone can download the latest free demo from the Dandy Ace Steam Page and participate in the event. Players can also hop into Twitch streams and participate in Twitch Mode as a viewer throughout the event period!

[b]Twitch Mode[/b] is always unlocked right from the start for any Twitch streamers to take advantage of across any difficulty settings they have unlocked. While playing in Twitch Mode players will continue to be able to unlock all of the same content available in the Standard Mode and will be able to switch between the two modes while maintaining their progress in the run. The mode can be customized to the streamers liking, turning on only the specific voting features they want. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/37cNZ49/Twitch-Mode-Giff.gif[/img]

Twitch Mode allows viewers to be able to interact directly with the streamer through chat. Viewers can decide how they want to impact the streamer’s run whether it be to help them progress or make things more challenging overall. Votes are held to determine which level the streamer will head to next, which cards will drop during the run, and one lucky viewer will also have the opportunity to become Dandy Ace’s antagonist, Lele the Green-Eyed Illusionist! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/129bcee6356368a76ce46cd5fd7501c0de4b95e6.png[/img]

Twitch Mode features several different options that can be turned on or off by the streamer, including:

[h3][u]Lele Mode[/u][/h3]
When activated, “Lele Mode” allows one viewer to become Lele for a short period of time. Viewers apply for the role by typing “Lele” into chat when prompted to do so. Lele is then randomly selected from those that have applied and is able to interact with the streamer via chat commands. 

As Lele, the viewer gains access to a handful of his Magic Tricks and Cards for a period of time to try to stop Ace from progressing such as:
[u][b]Cards/Skills[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Time Dissonance
[*] Black Hole
[*] Call Lightning
[*] Escape Artist
[*] Packet Trick
[/list]

[u][b]Magic Tricks[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] [b]Block Random Card[/b]
[list][*] Blocks a card from being used for a short period of time[/list]
[*] [b]Block Tea Potion[/b]
[list][*] Prevents Ace from using Tea Potions to heal for a period of time[/list]
[*] T[b]witch Cupcake[/b]
[list][*] A cupcake that can either heal or damage Ace, but it will never kill Ace fully.[/list]
[*][b] Spawn Random Enemies[/b]
[list][*] Several enemies will spawn around Ace with the viewer’s name above them[/list]
[/list]

[u][h3]Level Selection Poll[/h3][/u]
The Level Selection Poll gives viewers control over the streamer’s path through the Cursed Mirror and Lele’s Palace. Viewers in the chat are able to vote on the next level the streamer will have to enter and get through.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/d438f6f25e2d4a2428c9bd4323f0a66cdc4948ea.png[/img]

[u][h3]Twitch Cards[/h3][/u]
With this feature enabled viewers in the chat will be able to vote for the card you will receive from Arenas, Treasure Chests, and one card at the Shopkeepers. This replaces the cards you would normally receive from these drops.

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/fGTw0mR/Twitch-Card-Gif.gif[/img][/url]


[h3][u]Twitch Reward Tent[/u][/h3]
The Twitch Reward Tent replaces the Reward Tents found in Standard Mode at the beginning of each level. When the Twitch Reward Tent is enabled, viewers in the chat are able to vote on what additional prize you will earn along with replenishing your Tea Potions.

[h3][u]Twitch Reaction[/u][/h3]
When Twitch Reaction is enabled, users are able to send short messages to the streamer that will appear on screen. This feature will only appear after defeating a boss or after dying. 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/dabe4ba9bf0d885cad97df36b3d9991e4a3d40bf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/78c042d1680517a0fb3a2a9c5f9fd9a0bfe9ac71.png[/img][/url]

[h3]**Update**[/h3]

[b]More customization options!: [/b]We added an Advanced Settings screen that will allow streamers to customize the duration of Twitch Mode interactions. Adjust how often each vote feature appears and for how long.

[b]Twitch Assist:[/b] With this new Twitch Mode tool viewers can help the player by giving them random buffs or spawning healing cupcakes.

[*] At the start of each level we’ve added a new intractable object, the Palace Map. This shows an overview of the Palace layout.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/ac84058e3987080c0a0f15cd5bf1ca29dce54251.png[/img]

[u][h3]New Trinkets[/h3][/u][list]
[*]We’ve added 5 new trinkets into the game.[list]
[*] [b]Discharged Shoes[/b]: After 5 seconds without taking damage, Ace's Main Cards deals more damage. The damage increases as Ace progresses through the Palace.
[*] [b]Protagonist Fist[/b]: After killing an enemy Ace's Main Cards deals more damage for 10 seconds. The damage increases as Ace progresses through the Palace.
[*] [b]Invocation Mastery (Blueprint Required)[/b]: Increases all Condition's damage. The damage increases as Ace progresses through the Palace. This trinket effects: Bleed, Burn, and Poison.
[*] [b]Blue Deck (Blueprint Required)[/b]: Blue Skills deals more damage. The damage increases as Ace progresses through the Palace.
[*] [b]Cloak of the Virtuoso (Blueprint Required)[/b]: When Ace's HP is full, his Main Cards deals more damage. The damage increases as Ace progresses through the Palace.
[/list][/list]
[u][h3]Nnif-Tar Machine[/h3][/u][list]
[*] We added a machine next to all shops which is able to upgrade a card’s tier.[list]
[*] The machine will be broken to begin with and can be fixed by purchasing an upgrade with Shards.[/list][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/822be93a2dfba7ec9fa0fd7da0bac2d0bdd20788.png[/img]

[u][h3]Shop Reshuffle [/h3][/u][list]
[*] Players can now reshuffle the cards available at a shop.[list]
[*] Players start with 1 free reshuffle and can purchase additional free reshuffles through Shard upgrades.
[*] After all free reshuffles have been used, players must spend gold.[/list][/list]
[u][h3]Boss Levels[/h3][/u][list]
[*] The Boss Fights now have their own unique visual environments.[/list]
[u][h3]Twitch Mode[/h3][/u][list]
[*] We have enabled Twitch Mode for Twitch streamers to use.[list]
[*] Twitch Mode adds the ability for streamers to have their viewers interact with them through chat. They can vote on things such as the next level, which cards the player receives, and one viewer can even play as LeLe. They will be  able to choose from a variety of dialogue options to support or taunt the streamer as well as activate different skills.[/list][/list]
[h2]2. Balance Changes[/h2]
[u][h3]Character movement[/h3][/u][list]
[*] We’ve adjusted and improved Ace’s movement.[/list]
[u][h3]Portals and Map Adjustments[/h3][/u][list]
[*] Players now can access and teleport to the various portals on the level from both the Portals themselves and the Map. 
[*] Players can also teleport to unused Cupcakes, Cards and Blueprints directly.[/list]
[u][h3]Skills Updates and Rebalancing[/h3][/u][list]
[*] [b]Shooting Stars[/b]: We added some slight AoE damage onto the first two stars.
[*] [b]Skills with Hold mechanics[/b]: We reduced the Cooldown and Recovery time for skills with these mechanics to improve the overall feel of those skills.[list]
[*] [b]Bubble Trouble[/b] and [b]Sim Sala Beam[/b]: Have had their damage increased.[/list]
[*] [b]All Blink Skills[/b]: Reduced cooldown time.
[*] [b]All Dash Skills[/b]: Increased the hitbox area.
[*] [b]Blue Cards Skills[/b]: Reduced the CC duration effect of Blue Skills[list]
[*] Upgrade effects used on a Blue Card have also had their duration reduced.[list]
[*] Stun / Fear / Charm / Slow / Bind[/list][/list]
[*] [b]Offensive Yellow Cards[/b]: Damage has been increased[list]
[*] Deadly Cleanse / Consume Power / Packet Trick / Cosmic Vortex / Vanish[/list]
[*] [b]Starburst[/b]: Size of has been increased
[*] [b]Toxic Veil Rework[/b]: We have reworked this card and it is now called [b]Toxic Spray[/b].[list]
[*] Changed the skill from a line in front of Ace to a frontal cone AoE attack.[/list]
[*] [b]Minor Lightning Effect[/b]: Size of the AoE has been increased.[/list]
[u][h3]Trinket Rebalancing[/h3][/u][list]
[*] [b]Lightning Reflexes[/b] and [b]Combat Casting[/b]:[list] 
[*] Both of these Trinkets now give 15% damage reduction for their respective damage types.
[*] Removed the negative effect from each.[/list]
[*] [b]Trap Senses[/b]: Increased the hazard effectiveness on enemies and decreased the hazard effectiveness on Ace.
[*] [b]Vampirism[/b]: Reduced the amount of healing Ace received.
[*] [b]Spiked Shoes[/b]: Increased the duration of the effect. [/list]
[u][h3]Enemy Rebalancing[/h3][/u][list]
[*] Increased all enemies attack and move speed.
[*] Slightly increased all enemies HP.
[*] Increased the range the enemy starts to chase the player.[/list]
[h2]3. Other Changes[/h2]
[u][h3]Languages[/h3][/u][list]
[*] Additional languages are now available in the game.[list] 
[*] English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, German, Korean, Chinese (Traditional and Simplified), Russian and Polish.[/list][/list]
[u][h3]Palace Records[/h3][/u][list]
[*] Improved the UI and added various Icons.[/list]

notes.title: Dandy Ace 0.0.9.0.4 Update
notes.content:
In this patch we added a lot of new features such as Twitch Mode, Narration and Game Records! We used some of the community suggestions to help improve aspects like UI, gameplay, and visual feedback of card cooldowns and enemy behavior. We also made some changes and balance adjustments to some of the blue and yellow cards. 

[u][h2]New Features[/h2][/u]
[h3]Twitch Mode (Content Creators Build Only)[/h3]
Twitch Integration is a feature focused on streamers, giving them a lot of room and tools for direct interactions with their audiences. It allows them to play the game in a unique way that can only be experienced while streaming the game.

The chat of the streamer can interact with the game through:
[list]
[*] [b]Lele Mode[/b]: One viewer is picked from the chat, being granted the power to control Lele. This  allows them to use skills, spells and spawn enemies.
[*] [b]All Chat Interactions[/b]: During the streamer’s run, there will be many interactions that Twitch chat can vote on to decide what will happen in the game. Like deciding which kind of card the streamer will receive as reward and which level they should go to next.
[/list]
[h3]Narrator[/h3]
Throughout the game, Lele will comment on Ace's actions and interact with him through a wide variety of voice lines.

[h3]Dialogues[/h3]
We added a new dialogue system with all of the NPCs, bosses and tutorials. In addition to some new UI for it, now all of the characters have their own unique art and voices.

[h3]Game Records[/h3]
We added an interactable mirror at the entrance to each level. With it, players can check their:
[list]
[*] [b]Unlockable information:[/b] Most used cards, trinkets and permanent upgrades. As well as which items the player has already unlocked. 
[*] [b]Progression information:[/b] How many times they died, beat the game and their best times on each level.
[*] [b]Enemy information:[/b] How many times the player has killed or been killed by each enemy.
[/list]
[h3](Community Suggestion) Cooldown Feedback[/h3]
We heard players complain about not really knowing when their skills are off cooldown and having to look at their skill bar, averting their focus from the gameplay, and potentially putting them in danger while doing so. To help with this issue, we implemented the following changes based on feedback regarding skill cooldowns:
[list]
[*] Yellow Card's icons briefly appear above Ace when the skill gets off cooldown.
[*] Added visual feedback on all cards to show when a card is still on cooldown (on skill bar HUD).
[*] Added visual feedback on all cards to show when a card gets off cooldown (on skill bar HUD).
[*] Added audio feedback on cards with longer cooldown to indicate when a card is still on cooldown.
[/list]
[h3]Tooltip System[/h3]
We noticed some important mechanics of the game weren’t being easily understood and used as quickly as we wanted players to use them. To help players understand them a bit better, we added a simple tooltip system that is triggered when cards are equipped in a certain order.

[u][h2]Changes & Balancing[/h2][/u]
[h3]Blue Cards[/h3]
- Reduced all of the dash and blink cooldowns and adjusted the damage accordingly.

[h3]Yellow Cards[/h3]
- Reduced the overall cooldown of Yellow Cards and adjusted the damage accordingly.

[h3]Difficulty[/h3]
[b](Community Feedback) Entrance Hall reduction:[/b] We heard a lot of new players talking about the length of the first level and that it took longer than it should. We agreed that as an introductory level it didn’t need to be that long. So we removed some rooms and rearranged the map  to make it shorter. 

[b]Cupcake drop:[/b] On every level, cupcakes would drop 2 to 3 times. We have increased the drop rate to make sure that 3 cupcakes will spawn on each level.

[b](Community Feedback) Initial Pink Card:[/b] We felt that for new players the constant change in skills for their first few attempts could be a bit too difficult. To improve that we made the starter pink card always be Five of a Kind (similarly with how the start blue card is always Dashing Dash). Once players get to the Banquet Hall for the first time, they can unlock a cheap upgrade that will expand the number of starter pink cards the player can receive.

[b](Community Feedback) Card Gold Prices:[/b] We updated the shop’s Card prices, making them more accessible.

[h3](Community Feedback) Enemy Attack Feedback[/h3]
We improved the feedback that indicates when an enemy will be making an attack. This makes it a lot easier to predict and react to the various attacks enemies have. To get to this result we did a few things: 
[list]
[*] Enemies grow bigger before attacking
[*] Enemies glow in white for longer before attacking
[*] Floating Damage numbers from Ace’s attacks were made a bit smaller and spread out more to make it easier for players to see the enemies while damaging them
[*] Now there is no overlap between feedback on enemies. Before this change, enemies would glow in white before attacking, but would get overlapped by a red glow when they got hit by Ace
[/list]
[b]And we addressed and fixed several bugs[/b]

Hey everyone,

We wanted to give our followers a quick update on some exciting Dandy Ace news! Starting right now — you can participate in our first official Beta Test! 

We’ve been working hard on a special build of the game opening up a new path to a brand new boss! Try your luck against Axolangelo or try out the new Gardens path and face off against Scissorella! In order to access the special beta build you will need to join the [b][url=https://bit.ly/2EA9KyY]Mad Mimic Community Discord[/url][/b] and follow the instructions in the [i][b]#beta-access[/b][/i] channel!

Everyone is welcome to join and we are excited to hear what you think about our new content! 
This beta test will run from October 7th until October 13th. With more to come in the future!

[u][b]IMPORTANT:[/b][/u] If you are participating in the Beta your old save data will be lost.

Join us after the beta in the [b][url=https://bit.ly/2EA9KyY]Mad Mimic Community Discord[/url][/b] on [b]Wednesday[/b], [b][url=https://www.timeanddate.com/countdown/generic?iso=20201014T11&p0=234&msg=Dandy+Ace+Beta+-+Talk+with+the+Devs&font=sanserif]October 14th, at 18:00 - 19:00 (UTC)[/url][/b] and chat with other Dandy Ace fans as well members of the Mad Mimic dev team. If you have any feedback or thoughts on Dandy Ace please let us know by filling out this survey!

If you have read all the way to here...well congratulations and thank you!
